patch_description: Structural redesign around a modular pipeline with multi-candidate generation and internal proxy scoring. Instead of one fixed cascade, the pipeline builds several zero-phase candidates (different process-noise scales, one-pole alphas, and curvature-clamp strengths — including a guarded second-difference clamp that directly attacks the never-improving slope-change count), then selects the candidate that minimizes an internal objective combining (a) sign-flip/slope-change count of the first difference, (b) curvature violation mass, and (c) fidelity to the smoothed reference (correlation-guarded). This auto-calibrates per signal toward the scoring metrics without needing the clean reference, while all stages remain zero-phase so lag is preserved.
